subject: Game Theory
title: Individual Rationality
description: Learn Individual Rationality in one minute.

hook.text: You design a perfect mechanism, but nobody participates. Why? Because players can do better staying home.

buildup.text: Individual rationality means every player must be at least as well off participating as not. No one joins to lose.

discovery.text: This constraint limits what mechanisms can achieve: you can't extract too much from players or they'll refuse to play.

twist.text: Governments bypass this with mandatory participation: taxes, jury duty, and the draft ignore individual rationality.

climax.text: The best mechanisms make participation obviously beneficial. Players join eagerly, not reluctantly.

punchline.text: A game nobody joins is a game nobody wins.

quiz.question: What does individual rationality require?
options: Participation must be at least as good as opting out
